fr_html: Sur la proposition de LORD PHILLIMORE, il est entendu que chaque membre sera libre de donner son avis sans être lié par un questionnaire.
en_html: On the suggestion of LORD PHILLIMORE, it was agreed that each member might express his opinion freely without being subjected to a "questionnaire".
